newsitem.title: JORDAN: Arsonists set Jordan investigator's car ablaze.
newsitem.headline: Arsonists set Jordan investigator's car ablaze.

text.p: Arsonists set fire to a car belonging to the family of Jordan's former intelligence chief who is heading investigations into the shooting of seven Israeli girls last month, a security spokesman said on Wednesday.

Petra state news agency quoted the spokesman as confirming reports that police were called before dawn on Tuesday to the house of Abdul-Halim Kilani, whose father Mohammad is leading the investigation into the shooting by a Jordanian soldier at the border area of Baqoura.

The unnamed official also confirmed press reports that flames erupted from the hood of a Mercedes car owned by Mohammad Kilani but used by his son Abdul-Halim and that they found bits of carpet and tyres soaked in petrol under the car.
The spokesman said civil defence put out the fire.
"A financial reward of 10,000 dinars has been allocated for any one who would provide information on the perpetrators of the crime," the spokesman said. There was no comment on the motive.
